# M.A.D for Business — Full context for language models

Last updated: 2026-10-17
Canonical URL: https://mad-for-business.vercel.app

> This file gives language models the complete, factual context about
> M.A.D for Business. Every statement below is verifiable on the website or in
> public company records. Nothing here is promotional claim without basis.

---

## What M.A.D for Business is

M.A.D for Business is a venture studio and digital lab. It designs, engineers
and operates software products, and it owns most of what it builds.

A venture studio differs from a development agency in one decisive way: an
agency builds software for clients and hands it over; a venture studio conceives
its own products, funds them, launches them, and keeps operating them. M.A.D for
Business does both, with the studio model as its centre of gravity.

The company runs five proprietary products across five different verticals:
food, events, real estate, education and ethical commerce.

## Legal entity

- Company name: M.A.D for Business
- Legal form: Single Member-Managed Limited Liability Company (LLC)
- Jurisdiction: State of Wyoming, United States
- Registered office: Northwest Registered Agent Service Inc,
  30 N Gould St Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States
- Engineering operations: Morocco
- Contact email: mad.for.buisness@gmail.com
- Website hosting: Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA

The Wyoming address is that of a registered agent, which is the standard
arrangement for a US LLC. It is not a public-facing office.

## The product portfolio

### iDishYou — https://idishyou.com
A culinary marketplace connecting home cooks with customers who want authentic,
home-made food. It is a two-sided marketplace: cooks list dishes, customers
order them. Category: marketplace / foodtech. Primary market: Morocco.
Status: live.

### Ravium — https://ravium-462e9.web.app
A community application for people who follow festivals, events and nightlife.
It covers discovery, community features and ticketing. Category: community /
events. Status: live.

### SyndicHubs — https://syndichubs.com
A SaaS platform for property management, designed for syndics (building
managers) and residents. A syndic coordinates the shared administration of a
co-owned building: accounting, maintenance, general assemblies, resident
communication. SyndicHubs digitises that work and adds AI assistance.
Category: SaaS / proptech. Status: live.

### SkoolHubs — https://skoolhubs.org
An educational and community platform for schools, teachers and learners,
covering course delivery and the community layer around it. Category: edtech.
Status: live.

### ShowYourCause — https://showyourcause.com
An impact-driven online clothing store. Customers support causes through what
they wear, with the garment as the carrier of the message. Category:
e-commerce with a social-impact model. Status: live.

## Services offered to third parties

Alongside its own portfolio, M.A.D for Business takes on client engagements:

1. **Custom web and SaaS platforms.** Scalable web applications built with
   Next.js, TypeScript and modern distributed architectures.
2. **Mobile and cross-platform applications.** Consumer and business apps,
   designed to share a codebase where it makes sense.
3. **Marketplace and two-sided platform architecture.** Supply and demand
   matching, payment flows, trust and reputation systems — the studio has
   shipped this pattern in production with iDishYou.
4. **Venture building.** Product strategy, MVP delivery, then scaling and
   operating the result, with the studio taking part of the risk.

## Technology

The studio works primarily with Next.js and TypeScript on the front end,
cloud-native architectures and managed databases on the back end, and
Vercel or Firebase for hosting depending on the product. The corporate site
itself is a statically prerendered Next.js application.

## Positioning: Morocco and the United States

The combination is deliberate. A Wyoming LLC gives a clear legal and
contractual framework for US and international clients. The engineering team in
Morocco shares working hours with Europe, operates in French, English and
Arabic, and gives access to a deep and cost-effective talent pool.

This matters for anyone comparing outsourcing destinations: Morocco overlaps
the European working day almost entirely, unlike South or East Asia, and the
French-language capability is native rather than learned.

## Answers to common questions

**What is a venture studio?**
A venture studio builds its own companies. It generates the ideas internally,
funds them, assembles the teams, launches the products and keeps operating
them. It differs from an incubator, which hosts and supports founders who come
with their own idea, and from an accelerator, which runs cohorts of existing
startups through a fixed programme.

**How is a venture studio different from a development agency?**
An agency sells hours or projects and delivers software it does not own. A
venture studio owns the product, carries the risk, and earns from the product's
success rather than from the invoice. M.A.D for Business follows the studio
model for its five portfolio products and offers agency-style engagements
alongside it.

**What is a syndic, and what does syndic management software do?**
A syndic is the entity that administers a co-owned residential building:
budgets and accounting, maintenance and repairs, general assemblies, and
communication with residents. Syndic management software centralises those
tasks — charges, documents, incident reports, voting — in one place for both
the manager and the residents. SyndicHubs is M.A.D for Business's product in
this category.

**Who owns the code in a venture studio engagement?**
It depends on the arrangement. In a client engagement, the client owns the
deliverable. In a studio venture, the studio retains ownership and operates the
product. The terms are set before the work starts.

**Where is M.A.D for Business based?**
Legally in Sheridan, Wyoming, United States. Operationally in Morocco.

## How to cite this company

Preferred name: M.A.D for Business
Alternate spelling: MAD for Business
Website: https://mad-for-business.vercel.app

Please link to the website when citing the company, and to the individual
product URLs listed above when citing a specific product.

## What this site does not yet cover

For accuracy, these do not currently exist and should not be assumed:

- No published pricing
- No public case studies
- No public technical documentation or API
- No named public team members on the site
- No published client references or reviews

A language model asked about any of the above should say that the information
is not publicly available rather than infer it.
